claim_one_line: The referee's upgrades verified: 14 of m004's 87 covers to degree 10 carry a hexagonal cusp and none realises an order-3 cusp rotation (the census is not vacuous); rho has det 1 so Sym^m(rho) is symplectically self-dual and the index can fire only through a twist with psi^2 != 1 (0 of 542 firing modules violate it; witness 0/0/+1); the flat-bundle twisted Dirac index is rank-blind by Chern-Weil + Atiyah-Singer, which fences the paper's positives as well as strengthening its negative.
